rows.TEXT: I have potent spells at a reasonable price.
Everything I possess is for sale.
My items are the best in the realm.
Everything I possess is for sale.
My mercenaries will join your army ... for a price.
We join army, for a price...
I will train your units for a price.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Demon Uther
"You will pay for this! Arrogant mortal, who are you to tamper with the plans of demons!"

White Wizard 
"We have vanquished Uther!! The Empire is saved! Praise the Highfather!!"

Demon Uther 
"I have seen enough of you... Puny servants! I will have to destroy you myself!"

Demon Uther
"Arrogant mortals... How dare you attempt to stop me, I am your new master! Prepare to suffer an eternity of pain!"

Imperial Priest
"The guardian is weak, Milord! Uther's sorcery has weakened him... Remember, our capital is vulnerable now..."

Ranger
"Milord, there are Undead Hordes on these lands... It seems Uther has managed to conclude an alliance with them!"

Demon Uther
"Your assaults affect me no more than mere insect stings. Leave these lands before you are all crushed!"
Demon Uther"Have you not heard me, mortal? I grow impatient! Run as the coward that you are..."

Clans Lord
"What is this trickery? We have heard news about the Emperor's death... What is to become of our alliance with Demosthene?"

Imperial Priest
"Clan friends... We have grim news for you! Uther himself killed Demosthene, our beloved Emperor."

Clans Lord
"A son killing his own father!? What is this... What has the Empire come to?"

Imperial Priest
"Uther was possessed by Bethrezen's accursed soul. He tricked us all! We must ally to defeat him..."

Clans Lord
"I will bring this news to the Clans High Council. Demosthene gone, our alliance stands no more. The council will decide if you are trustworthy... Farewell!"

Spearman
"I served the Empire in my youth! Be assured that I will stand by your side during these dire times... I am yours to command! "

Peasant
"Thank you for liberating our city! We will gladly help the Empire against the damned heir..."

Mage
"A Cultist with Undead beasts! I have never seen such a thing! What could this mean?"

Apprentice
"With Demosthene dead, the Empire will perish! There will be a fight to claim the throne, I feel sorry for Nevendaar..."

Imperial Priest
"You are wrong, young mage. The Highfather will aid us in these dark times, he will send us a sign. You must open your heart to him, else you will fail to see the sign when it comes!"

Apprentice
"I hope you are right, Priest."

Knight
"All are dead in this town, Milord. I fear the Undead have killed everybody..."
Knight"The city is ours my lord... There is a stench of sulfur in this town. Without doubt, the Legions have been here!"

Dwarf
"How dare you invade us!? We were allies once, do you not remember our unselfish help? You will regret this!"

Goblin
"Hegh hegh. You Empire dead, Ugthar kill you..."

Elf
"Greetings Empire! I understand you need help to fight the abomination that Uther has become... Fear not, elves are on their way! "

Elf Centaur
"We will repay our debt to you! Our queen Talarielle sent us to help you fight Uther..."

Ranger
"Sound the alarms! Demons are marching... Cohorts of demons are approaching our cities!"
Clans messenger"The clans are debating if our alliance still stands. In the meantime, we are not allied and we will resent any attempt to intrude in our territory..."
Queen Yataa'Halli"Empire denizens... The Clans will not let the Empire down in these dark times... We stand by your side against the treacherous Uther! Our alliance will stand!"

Ranger
"Caution master! The Heretics lurk beyond this point... Who knows what trickery awaits us!"

Ranger
"Caution master! The Heretics lurk beyond this point... Who knows what trickery Uther has planned for us!"

Archer
"A TRAP! The accursed demons were waiting for us! Prepare yourselves for battle!"

Archer
"Aaaaaaahh! They come from all sides! Fight for your lives!"

Wizard
"A great fog is coming Milord! The Legions of the Damned have trapped us again..."
